title: Check Sorted Circular Shift
description:
You are given an array of integers. Determine whether the array can be obtained by taking a non-decreasing sorted array and applying a circular shift (rotation) any number of times, including zero.

In other words, check if the array was originally sorted and then rotated.

Duplicates are allowed in the array.

You must read input from standard input and print the result accordingly.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n — the number of elements.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print "true" if the array can be obtained by rotating a non-decreasing sorted array, otherwise print "false".
